2605.28605.title: Internally Referenced Low-Light Enhancement
2605.28605.authors: He, Peiyuan and Wang, Hainuo and Liu, Hengxing and Li, Mingjia and Guo, Xiaojie
2605.28605.verbatim_from_body: quantile-based robust white balancing; by isolating the top q-th quantile luminance Q_q(.) of the input I_low; local maximum Imax to yield a rough amplification map G_rough = 1/(Imax + eps)
2605.28605.why_cited: Closest prior mechanism to our correction: upper-quantile anchor with reciprocal amplification. Applied to the INPUT as an internal reference inside an enhancer; ours divides the OUTPUT of an already-trained model as a post-hoc correction.
